variables.description: Columns to examine. Empty means every column except the group variable.

group.description: Optional column to split the per-variable summary by.

naValues.description: Values that stand for missing in the source data, e.g. "-99" or "" (empty string). Treated as missing for this analysis only.

variableSummary.description: Missing count and percentage per variable.

caseSummary.description: Number of rows by how many values they miss.

patterns.description: Table of missingness patterns (which variables are missing together).

variables.description: Bar chart of missing percentage per variable.

matrix.description: Where values are missing, row by variable.

upset.description: UpSet plot of combinations of missing variables (needs naniar and UpSetR).

method.description: mice method for numeric variables (factors get mice's defaults).

saveAs.description: If set, the mids object is saved in the R session under this name.
